[Harbour Yacht Club]

October news

Dear members,

The autumn regatta ended on Sunday with light winds and a close finish. Marisol took first place, two seconds ahead of Blue Heron.

Winter storage

Boats must be out of the water by 30 November. Book your slot at the office.

Book a slot (https://click.harbour-yc.example/c/1?u=8e7a6&id=55f0e&e=member)

The new pontoon opens on 4 November.
